title: Make app-native library logs visible in the child (liblog -> hilog + gated stderr)
status: VM-side done (source change + build verified); on-board Toutiao verification pending an outer-loop board slot (5cd1e3dd is occupied by #42's Toutiao timing)
mode: VM-side only this round: read-only source archaeology + one source file + a single-library rebuild; no board run yet

root_cause.symptom: app-native __android_log_print / __android_log_buf_write in the child (Cronet/ttnet/Lynx/metasec) are silently lost; only the Java Log.println_native path (B.37) was fixed
root_cause.finding: the hilog bridge (android_log_hilog_bridge.cpp, which calls __android_log_set_logger to route to HiLogPrint) is compiled into liboh_adapter_bridge.so and liboh_android_runtime.so, NOT into liblog.so
root_cause.evidence: out-all0925/core-runtime/liblog.so exports __android_log_print/__android_log_set_logger/__android_log_write_log_message but has NO HiLogPrint / 0xD000F00 / register_hilog reference; the D000F00 strings live in liboh_adapter_bridge.so and liboh_android_runtime.so
root_cause.mechanism: __android_log_set_logger just sets a per-liblog-instance global (logger_write.cpp: logger_function = logger; no abort). The liblog instance the app's native libs bind (a copy in the ART classloader namespace, and/or one whose logger the framework never set) keeps liblog's default logd writer, whose socket is dead on OH -> messages dropped
root_cause.why_it_downgraded_41: on OH the METASEC log tag is native (E METASEC : MSTaskManager::DoLazyInit) so its absence from child.stderr proves nothing until this channel works

fix.how: a __attribute__((constructor)) calls __android_log_set_logger so EVERY liblog instance self-registers a logger at load; this reaches the app-namespace liblog copy that the misplaced bridge never touched
logger_behaviour: hilog: HiLogPrint(LOG_TYPE_CORE=3, level, domain 0xD000F00, tag, "%{public}s", msg) — same domain/route as B.37; HiLogPrint resolved via dlopen(libhilog.so)+dlsym so liblog.so gains NO hard libhilog dependency and stays loadable in every namespace

stderr: when WESTLAKE_SOURCE_LOG_STDERR=1, also write(2, ...) in logcat form "<prio> <tag> : <msg>\n"; env read once and cached; unset (default, and every #38 timing run) skips the stderr branch entirely
fix.source_commit: e627b770b05f1da2fd9752217cd308e58feaf023 (branch fix/native-log-sink-44 in the westlake source repo; only committed, not pushed; shared tree restored to detached 22b9453)

on_board_acceptance_pending.requires: an outer-loop-assigned board slot (must not run Toutiao while #42 times it on 5cd1e3dd)
on_board_acceptance_pending.deploy: overlay out-log44/lib/liblog.so onto the runtime staging's liblog.so, launch Toutiao via probe_source_app.py with --runtime-env WESTLAKE_SOURCE_LOG_STDERR=1
checks: child.stderr shows app-native log lines (Cronet/ttnet/Lynx/metasec tags)
volume order-of-magnitude comparable to the Android reference N100CU025C18D000128 logcat's same-process native tags; list the tag-set differences
no main-thread slowdown: #38 queueMs before/after unchanged (stderr off by default, so only the diagnostic run pays; measure it)
answer definitively: does METASEC / MSTaskManager::DoLazyInit appear on OH (the #41 open question)

verdicts.item: root cause: bridge absent from liblog.so; app-namespace liblog uses dead logd
verdicts.verdict: verified (symbol/string inspection of the built libs)

verdicts.item: sink compiled into liblog.so, self-registers, routes to hilog + gated stderr
app-native logs visible in child.stderr on Toutiao
